page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 16 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance features 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average multi-core capabilities but weaker single-core execution. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is categorized in the bottom 25%, and single-threaded operations like gzip compression and bzip3 decompression rank in the bottom 10%. However, multi-threaded tasks show better scaling, with stress-ng multi-core performance, bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, and PassMark CPU scores all falling within the middle 50% average. Memory bandwidth is stable, with cached small-block reads reaching 655.24 GB/sec and uncached large-block writes at 59.92 GB/sec.

This instance offers a balanced resource density suitable for workloads that benefit from multi-threaded processing rather than raw single-core speed. Database operations, static web serving, and Redis SET operations perform at average levels. It is also capable of handling lightweight LLM inference for small models, though performance drops significantly on medium models. The ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is best suited for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded application servers, static web serving, and moderate database deployments.
